scenarioUse: Primary-care coordination qualification source; not medical or legal advice.

controls.requirement: Registration is voluntary and records agreement by the patient and the registered practice; a patient has one current registered practice and may nominate a preferred GP.
The practice is registered for MyMedicare and the linked GP is eligible and has a valid provider number.
The registration workflow records informed consent and retains evidence of the registration decision.
Health information is collected, used and disclosed for the consented care-coordination purpose unless a specific lawful exception applies.
